name: Effective VC Radius / Interpolation Degree
details: The proposed bound $\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal H)$ fails by an unbounded factor, even for finite binary classes.
proof: For the cube-with-apex family $\mathcal A_n$, every coordinate is effective but the pair consisting of the apex coordinate and any base coordinate is not shattered, so $\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal A_n)=1$. Its full $n$-cube base forces interpolation degree at least $n$, and the base monomials together with the apex coordinate give a degree-$n$ interpolating basis. Thus $\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal A_n)=n$.
witness_verification: For every $n\geq1$, the established values are $\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal A_n)=1$ and $\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal A_n)=n$.
